summary: The core issue was whether the Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad (Board) has statutory authority to determine service conditions, including pensionary benefits, of its employees under the 1965 Act. The Supreme Court held that clause (f) of sub-section (1) of Section 95 of the 1965 Act empowers the Board to frame regulations on service conditions, and that the State Government could not override this power via the 1975 Act. The Court affirmed the Allahabad High Court's judgment directing implementation of the new pension scheme under the Board's notification of 19 May 2009, and directed the Board to release pending pensionary benefits within three months.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 3, Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad Adhiniyam, 1965
Section 2(1), U.P. State Control Over Public Corporations Act, 1975
State of Uttar Pradesh v. Preetam Singh & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; the Board directed to implement the new pension scheme and release pensionary benefits to eligible retired employees within three months as per the notification dated 19th May 2009
